instructions.what: Pick the single next change that would bring this game scene's look closest to the creator's intent. state.brief is the creative brief; state.facts.look describes the current frame in words; state.facts.findings lists what a generic polish checklist flagged. The checklist assumes a bright, fully dressed showcase, so some flags may be intentional for this brief and must be left alone. Choose the change that best serves the brief's mood and intended player feeling.
instructions.not_for: Never pick a change that adds something listed in brief.avoid or pushes the look away from the brief's mood. Do not pick a fix only because its flag is marked severe. Pick keep_as_is only when every remaining flag is intended by the brief and nothing else is needed.

criteria.keep_as_is: Change nothing: the look already serves the brief and every remaining flag is intentional.
criteria.apply_look: Apply a full look preset (sun, fog and color grading together) matching the brief's mood; best when the frame is ungraded or its overall mood is wrong for the brief.
criteria.add_key_light: Add base lighting from a lighting preset; only when there are no lights at all.
criteria.add_fill_light: Add fill and rim point lights so shadows are not pitch black and shapes separate from the background.
criteria.fix_light_budget: Remove or shrink lights that exceed the renderer's light budget.
criteria.enable_shadows: Turn on shadow casting for the main light so objects sit on the ground.
criteria.add_hdri: Add an HDRI environment map for natural ambient light, reflections and color.
criteria.add_fog: Add volumetric fog for atmosphere, depth and visible light shafts.
criteria.add_bloom: Turn on bloom so bright lights and emissive things glow.
criteria.add_vignette: Add a vignette that darkens the frame corners to pull the eye to the center.
criteria.soften_godrays: Weaken god rays so fog and god rays do not double the light scattering.
criteria.add_motion: Add small moving particles (drifting dust, embers, insects) so the frame feels alive.
criteria.add_surface_detail: Apply normal maps and varied roughness so materials read as wood, metal or cloth instead of plastic.
criteria.enable_ssao: Turn on ambient occlusion so objects darken where they meet.
criteria.enable_contact_shadow: Turn on contact shadows for tight shadows under small objects.
criteria.deepen_contrast: Lower the ambient light and raise contrast so the frame has deeper shadows and a wider tonal range.
criteria.lower_exposure: Lower the exposure to recover blown-out white areas.
criteria.lift_shadows: Raise the ambient or fill light so crushed pure-black areas show detail and the frame gets brighter.
criteria.boost_color: Raise color saturation so the frame is not gray.
criteria.add_decals: Add dirt, stains and wear decals so the place looks used and lived in.
criteria.tone_down_grading: Tone down exaggerated grading: weaker bloom, less saturation and less contrast, for a natural look.
